subject: p-fc
title: (R)P.FC.------AFI.
description: Chart on book p. 37 (SD(SY)-15). P-FC (particular focus) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) and TR (transformation). From DYM-SPT: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From EXT-FT: FUND-DYM (fundamental dynamics). From TR: WO-EXP-P and UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). From WO-EXP-P: VT-IMP (vibrational implications). From VT-IMP: C-CONT (composite continuance). The page text speaks of "the vibrational implications of progressionalism".
